# PowerLink v1.0.2 — Wave + Circuit branding

## What's new

- Updated all PowerLink branding to the approved v6 PowerLink glyph, built around the exact PowerPlay v10 lightning-bolt silhouette. The bolt fades **blue at the upper-right through cyan to silver-white at the lower-left**, between a silver-white left link and electric-blue right link.
- Preserved the original high-detail SVG at every size. No simplified or monochrome small icon, no alternate dark treatment.
- Replaced the Home Assistant integration icon/logo images with lossless optimized PNGs rendered **directly from the approved SVG** at the sizes Home Assistant requires; the same icon also serves dark mode.
- Updated the repository README banner and SVG wordmark to match.
- Added a reproducible branding generator and automated source-hash checks so future releases cannot accidentally ship mismatched artwork.

## Compatibility

This update changes **branding and metadata only**; no changes to PowerShuffle, queue preservation, Fire TV wake, pairing, or handoff behavior.

Install or update PowerLink through HACS, then restart Home Assistant if prompted. Existing integrations, rooms, device registrations, and settings are preserved.

GPLv3 licensing and prior source notices remain unchanged.
